armsUnfalsifiable.detectedBy: harness/v2/arm-falsifiability.mjs (added after this was found by hand)

reasons.detail: ttf2woff2@1.2.3 publishes 124 files including a working build/Release/addon.node and a 43-entry build/Release/ tree. artifact-gate.mjs keys on every file OBSERVE produced under the package dir, which for this package IS the shipped tarball set — present in every arm before any script runs. The reported artifacts=122/122 therefore passes identically for a working arm and a completely broken one.

The install script is `(node-gyp rebuild > builderror.log) || (exit 0)`, so rc is 0 whether the build worked or not. MEASURED on the corpus runner: the whole run contained 5 execs — sudo, env, node(npm), sh, env, node(node-gyp) — with no python, clang, make or cc, so node-gyp never reached a compiler. The install still reported rc=0.

armsUnfalsifiable.whyTheGrantIsStillRight: The package ships a working prebuilt binary, so a failed node-gyp genuinely costs it nothing and it genuinely needs no capability. The verdict and the truth agree; only the EVIDENCE is missing.
